_comment: The publication gate. A district gets a standalone page ONLY from a record here with status 'approved', a stated district-specific reason, and at least one evidence item. Everything else stays a draft and is served by the state hub and the national pages. Drafts are never rendered as public routes.

_fields.district_code: LGD code — the identity, not the name
_fields.reason_page_exists: the district-specific reason this page is separately useful. 'We want to rank in X' is not a reason.
_fields.evidence: verified, checkable items. Never a manufactured local claim.
_fields.delivery_mode: remote | remote+visits | on-site team — must be true
_fields.workflows: the 2-3 national workflow pages this district's buyers most need
_fields.blocker: for drafts: exactly what is missing before it could be approved
_fields.approved_by: who signed off the local claims
_fields.office_here: true only where sotyn.ai genuinely has premises in that district
